name: Question 5
problem:
Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curves $y={e}^{x},$ $y=\operatorname{ln}⁡x,$  and the lines $y=1-x$  and $y=1+e-x.$ 
Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.

Consider the finite region D in the xy-plane enclosed by the curves y=ex, y=ln⁡x, and the lines y=1−x and y=1+e−x. Express ∬Df(x,y)dA as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.

a
∫01∫1+xexf(x,y)dydx+∫1e∫ln⁡x1+e+xf(x,y)dydx
b
∫02∫1−xexf(x,y)dydx+∫2e∫ln⁡x1+e+xf(x,y)dydx
c
∫01∫1−xexf(x,y)dydx+∫1e∫ln⁡x1+e−xf(x,y)dydx
d
∫02∫1−xexf(x,y)dydx+∫2e∫ln⁡xe−xf(x,y)dydx
e
∫01∫ln⁡xexf(x,y)dydx+∫1e∫1−x1+e−xf(x,y)dydx
